scope: Executed local development/validation test register; not a production certification or participant usability study

cases.Test Description: Reject empty and unsupported image inputs
cases.Test Steps: Submit empty byte array and unsupported image payload
cases.Expected Result: Input is rejected without creating a receipt
cases.Actual Result: Both invalid inputs were rejected safely

cases.Test Description: Correct a receipt captured at a quarter turn
cases.Test Steps: Create rotated synthetic receipt; call preprocess; inspect orientation
cases.Expected Result: Output is returned in upright portrait orientation
cases.Actual Result: Orientation corrected and dimensions were valid

cases.Test Description: Avoid rotating a creased portrait receipt sideways
cases.Test Steps: Process portrait receipt containing a dominant crease
cases.Expected Result: Text-row evidence dominates the crease during orientation selection

cases.Test Description: Extract standard date, invoice number and payable total
cases.Test Steps: Pass OCR text to extract_fields and compare normalized values
cases.Test Data: INVOICE NO: INV-1001; DATE: 19/10/2026; TOTAL RM 102.50

cases.Test Description: Reject invalid calendar dates while preserving later valid values
cases.Test Steps: Parse text containing 31/02/2026 and a later valid date
cases.Expected Result: Invalid calendar candidate is rejected; valid candidate remains eligible

cases.Test Description: Select payable total instead of cash or change
cases.Test Steps: Parse receipt text containing TOTAL, CASH and CHANGE
cases.Expected Result: Payable total is selected
cases.Actual Result: TOTAL was selected; cash/change were not mislabelled

cases.Test Description: Preserve header, signature and large logos during crop
cases.Test Steps: Run crop tests on table, signature, handwriting and logo layouts
cases.Expected Result: No relevant edge content is removed
cases.Actual Result: Header, signature, handwriting, scripts and logo remained inside crop

cases.Test Description: Preserve source-supported text while suppressing paper shading
cases.Test Steps: Generate faithful view and inspect supported dark pixels
cases.Test Data: Synthetic faded text plus broad shading
cases.Expected Result: Source-supported ink retained; broad shading reduced; no typeset text

cases.Test Description: Validate review form fields and values
cases.Preconditions: Authenticated test client and owned receipt
cases.Test Steps: Submit missing merchant/date/amount and malformed values
cases.Expected Result: HTTP validation response names each invalid field; record is not verified
cases.Actual Result: Field-specific errors returned and invalid review rejected

cases.Test Description: Complete account and owned-receipt workflow
cases.Test Steps: Register; log in; create/read/update receipt; export and delete
cases.Expected Result: Only the owner completes the workflow successfully

cases.Test Description: Support guest workflow and isolate guest selection
cases.Test Steps: Create guest session; validate selection; attempt cross-session access
cases.Expected Result: Guest can use permitted functions and cannot access another session
cases.Actual Result: Guest workflow and isolation assertions passed

cases.Test Description: Generate readable audit PDF and accounting workbook
cases.Preconditions: Owned synthetic receipt with audit fields
cases.Test Steps: Request audit PDF and XLSX endpoints; inspect content and MIME
cases.Expected Result: Fixed report is readable; workbook includes accounting evidence and MyInvois boundary

cases.Test Description: Expose eight unrolled DSDNet stages and four maxout branches
cases.Preconditions: Pinned model configuration and PyTorch environment
cases.Test Steps: Run adapter forward pass and inspect stage/branch tensors
cases.Expected Result: Eight stages match pinned forward; four branches available

cases.Test Description: Contain native inference crash and recover worker
cases.Test Steps: Force native crash; submit a second receipt
cases.Expected Result: First job fails safely; fresh worker handles next job
cases.Actual Result: Crash contained and subsequent job completed

cases.Test Description: Continue batch after one invalid image
cases.Test Steps: Submit bad image followed by valid image
cases.Expected Result: Bad item reports error without cancelling following item

cases.Test Description: Return busy response for simultaneous scan
cases.Test Steps: Submit another scan concurrently
cases.Expected Result: Second request returns controlled busy response rather than blocking

cases.Test Description: Replace timed-out inference worker
cases.Test Steps: Start non-terminating job; wait for timeout; submit new job
cases.Expected Result: Hung worker is terminated and replaced

cases.Test Description: Deduplicate identical OCR views without losing text
cases.Test Steps: Supply identical OCR view records and merge
cases.Expected Result: Duplicate call removed; unique text retained
cases.Actual Result: Exactly one recognition retained per identical view

cases.Test Description: Enforce arithmetic consistency gate
cases.Test Steps: Provide inconsistent monetary fields and route review decision
cases.Test Data: Subtotal does not equal reported total
cases.Expected Result: Mismatch is reported and automatic verification blocked

cases.Test Description: Protect barcode region through restoration
cases.Preconditions: Barcode detector and restoration fusion loaded
cases.Test Steps: Restore image with barcode and compare protected region
cases.Expected Result: Barcode pixels are sourced from original region
cases.Actual Result: Barcode region was restored from original source

cases.Test Description: Detect duplicate HTML element IDs
cases.Test Steps: Parse all elements with id and count duplicates
cases.Expected Result: No duplicate IDs

cases.Test Description: Check explicit labels for interactive fields
cases.Test Steps: Inspect input/select/textarea for label or accessible name
cases.Expected Result: No unlabeled controls

cases.Test Description: Check accessible names for buttons
cases.Test Steps: Inspect button text, aria-label, aria-labelledby and title
cases.Expected Result: Every button has a visible or accessible name

cases.Test Description: Return field-specific registration errors
cases.Test Steps: Submit missing, malformed and inconsistent registration values
cases.Expected Result: Each invalid field receives a specific error

cases.Test Description: Limit receipt image choices to faithful, original and comparison
cases.Test Steps: Inspect available image-view controls
cases.Expected Result: No obsolete clean-view control; three intended choices present
cases.Actual Result: Faithful, original and compare controls only

cases.Test Description: Refresh one stale CSRF token transparently
cases.Test Steps: Trigger protected request and observe retry
cases.Expected Result: Client refreshes token once and retries without loop

cases.Test Description: Apply security headers and restrict anonymous access
cases.Test Steps: Request public and protected routes anonymously; inspect headers
cases.Expected Result: Security headers present; protected data denied

cases.Test Description: Prevent cross-user read, update and deletion
cases.Preconditions: Two registered accounts and one owned receipt
cases.Test Steps: Attempt receipt operations from non-owner account
cases.Test Data: User A receipt; User B session
cases.Expected Result: All cross-user operations are denied

cases.Test Description: Store passwords as hashes
cases.Test Steps: Register account; inspect stored credential
cases.Expected Result: Stored value is a password hash and not plaintext

cases.Test Description: Require CSRF token for mutations
cases.Test Steps: POST mutation without valid X-CSRF-Token
cases.Expected Result: Request is rejected

cases.Test Description: Neutralise spreadsheet formula injection
cases.Preconditions: Export endpoint and synthetic malicious values
cases.Test Steps: Export CSV/XLSX fields beginning with formula characters
cases.Expected Result: Exported cell is treated as text
cases.Actual Result: CSV and Excel outputs were neutralised

cases.Test Description: Deny non-admin access to admin resources
cases.Test Steps: Request and mutate admin endpoints
cases.Expected Result: All admin operations denied

cases.Test Description: Maintain tamper-evident event chain
cases.Test Steps: Read event chain and verify linked hashes
cases.Expected Result: Chain verifies and security headers remain present

cases.Test Description: Expose receipt file-integrity state to owner
cases.Test Steps: Request integrity information as owner
cases.Expected Result: Owner receives consistent integrity result
cases.Actual Result: Integrity state was visible to owner

cases.Test Description: Reject invalid upload and oversized/empty bulk request safely
cases.Test Steps: Submit invalid file, empty bulk list and over-limit list
cases.Expected Result: Requests fail safely without partial mutation

cases.Test Description: Scan source/config/tests for common secrets and dangerous constructs
cases.Test Steps: Run pattern scan, AST scan and pip check
cases.Expected Result: No hits; no dangerous constructs; dependencies consistent
cases.Actual Result: 0 secret hits; 0 dangerous constructs; pip check exit 0

cases.Test Description: Measure history endpoint with 250 records
cases.Preconditions: Temporary SQLite DB and guest session
cases.Test Steps: Issue 30 GET /api/receipts requests
cases.Expected Result: All HTTP 200; record p95 latency

cases.Test Description: Measure dashboard endpoint with 250 records
cases.Preconditions: Temporary SQLite DB and guest session
cases.Test Steps: Issue 30 GET /api/dashboard requests
cases.Expected Result: All HTTP 200; record p95 latency

cases.Test Description: Measure CSV export
cases.Test Steps: Issue 10 GET /api/export.csv requests
cases.Expected Result: All exports HTTP 200

cases.Test Description: Measure Excel export
cases.Test Steps: Issue 10 GET /api/export.xlsx requests
cases.Expected Result: All exports HTTP 200

cases.Test Description: Measure summary of 50 selected receipts
cases.Test Steps: Issue 30 selection-summary requests
cases.Expected Result: All requests HTTP 200

cases.Test Description: Exercise history endpoint at eight concurrent workers
cases.Test Steps: Run 64 requests through eight clients
cases.Expected Result: Zero failures; record p95 and throughput

cases.Test Description: Exercise dashboard endpoint at eight concurrent workers
cases.Test Steps: Run 64 requests through eight clients
cases.Expected Result: Zero failures

cases.Test Description: Exercise selection summary at eight concurrent workers
cases.Test Steps: Run 64 selection requests through eight clients
cases.Expected Result: Zero failures

cases.Test Description: Compare proposed method with direct degraded input
cases.Test Steps: Evaluate both methods on identical variants and aggregate by source
cases.Expected Result: Report paired metrics without claiming independent test evidence
cases.Actual Result: Proposed objective improved on all 86 sources

cases.Test Description: Compare proposed method with global Otsu
cases.Test Steps: Run Otsu and proposed method on identical variants
cases.Expected Result: Report SSIM, L1, objective and stroke metrics
cases.Actual Result: Proposed maintained higher SSIM across all three severity levels

cases.Test Description: Compare proposed method with Sauvola
cases.Test Steps: Run Sauvola and proposed method on identical variants
cases.Expected Result: Report fidelity/recall and false-stroke trade-off
cases.Actual Result: Proposed had higher SSIM and recall; Sauvola retained lower false-stroke rate

cases.Test Description: Compare proposed method with perceptual baseline
cases.Test Steps: Run perceptual baseline and proposed method on identical variants
cases.Expected Result: Report paired results by degradation severity
cases.Actual Result: Proposed had higher SSIM and recall at light, moderate and severe levels

cases.Test Description: Evaluate retained-stage depth
cases.Test Steps: Collect outputs after stages 1, 2, 4, 6 and 8; aggregate by source
cases.Expected Result: Identify whether full depth improves balanced objective
cases.Actual Result: Stage 8 achieved objective 0.0526 and SSIM 0.9167; stage 2 recall gain coincided with false-stroke rate 0.9682

cases.Test Description: Evaluate blur-kernel sensitivity
cases.Test Steps: Scale applied kernel by 0.50, 0.75, 1.00, 1.25 and 1.50
cases.Expected Result: Identify stable operating factor and trade-offs
cases.Actual Result: Factor 1.00 minimized objective (0.0526) and maximized SSIM (0.9167); factors 1.25/1.50 slightly reduced false strokes but worsened fidelity

cases.Test Description: Quantify robustness by degradation severity
cases.Test Steps: Aggregate light/moderate/severe metrics per source; run Friedman and paired Wilcoxon tests
cases.Expected Result: Report degradation trend and corrected significance
cases.Actual Result: SSIM fell 0.9410 to 0.8825 and objective rose 0.0390 to 0.0686; Friedman p<0.001

cases.Test Description: Analyse mixed and negative source-level findings
cases.Test Steps: Compute recall and false-stroke changes per source
cases.Expected Result: Count improvements and trade-off cases
cases.Actual Result: Objective improved 86/86; recall improved 79/86; 23 sources gained recall at a false-stroke cost

limitations: Usability evidence is a static interface heuristic plus automated workflow checks; it is not a participant study or accessibility certification.
Performance evidence uses a local Flask test client, temporary SQLite database and synthetic records; it is not a production load test or SLA.
Privacy/security evidence is automated regression and narrow source scanning; it is not a penetration test or data-protection impact assessment.
Restoration comparisons use the already examined locked development-validation partition; they are not a fresh independent test set.
